response.rationale: The item is electronics with days_since_delivery = 16, which is greater than 15. The electronics-specific rule RET-003 (priority 20) controls over the standard window rule RET-007 (priority 10). No higher-priority rule applies: final_sale is false, defective is null (not true), goodwill_grant and fraud_hold are false. Therefore the return is ineligible.
